test_adam_w_optimizer: test the AdamW optimizer converges to target values after 100 training steps with MSELoss
test_constant_lr_schedule: test the ConstantLRSchedule maintains a constant learning rate across multiple optimization steps
test_warmup_linear_schedule: test the WarmupLinearSchedule linearly warms up then linearly decays the learning rate
test_warmup_cosine_schedule: test the WarmupCosineSchedule warms up then applies cosine decay to the learning rate
test_schedule_state_save_reload: test saving and reloading scheduler state_dict preserves learning rate values across steps
